author: MrDogPT
body:
Hello. So, in this afternoon I was subbing for Cronus in a scrim vs Apollo and, in the end of the first match, i said to racist phares ( which I'm not proud of saying it ) just for fun, because i though that was funny.
Yup, I did wrong. 30 seconds befora I got Temp-ban, i though to myself.
« Why the fuck did u said that toby?»
So I'm not trying to apeal an infraction but trying to reduce the days of punishment, just because i've been doing well in terms of behavior in the last year (  I got 4 infractions in 1 year ).
I'm really sorry if I ofended anyone, I just didn't ment to ofend.
And I can't stay 2 weeks without Avicus....
Please, I beg you, could you reduce the days to 4/5 days?
I'm Thanks.
Regards, xToby.

title: xToby

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hey Toby,

Although Sli officialy punished you I was there and gave out the first infraction and therefore I will deal with this appeal.

You must understand that what you said was serious and can be considered extremely offensive and is strictly against our rules. However,
I don't believe you said it with an intent to offend anyone in chat and you have been fairly clean over the last couple of months so I am willing to shorten your ban to 7 days from the time of your punishment.

Please remember to read the rules and think before acting.

-Spoookeh
